user.title: Set up RESQIO
user.description: How should the connection be set up?

pairing.title: Pair with code
pairing.description: Create the code in RESQIO under Enterprise, Home Assistant, pair access. It is valid for 10 minutes and is used up when saved. If pairing fails, please create a new code.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter the access data from RESQIO (Enterprise, Home Assistant, access).

data_description.departments: The slugs of the released fire departments, e.g. hauptwache, ortsteil-nord.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair RESQIO
reauth_confirm.description: RESQIO has rejected the saved access. Create a new pairing code in RESQIO under Enterprise, Home Assistant, pair access. It is valid for 10 minutes and is used up when saved.

reconfigure.title: Pair RESQIO again
reconfigure.description: Pair again, for example after the fire department release was changed. Create a new code in RESQIO under Enterprise, Home Assistant, pair access. It is valid for 10 minutes and is used up when saved.

tls_notice.title: Connection not encrypted
tls_notice.description: The connection to the RESQIO broker is not encrypted. Access data and alarm data would travel through the network unprotected. {detail}\n\nOnly continue if the connection runs inside a network you trust, or ask your administrator to enable an encrypted connection.

error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Please check the server address and code.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
error.cannot_connect: The server or broker cannot be reached.
error.invalid_code: The code has an invalid format.
error.invalid_departments: The department slugs are invalid or duplicated.
error.invalid_certificate: The file is not a valid PEM certificate.

abort.already_configured: This access is already set up. Its access data were updated.
abort.wrong_account: This code belongs to a different access than the one being updated.
